title: Assistant lost our brand voice after upgrade
description: Initech Health (v3): answers sound generic since the platform upgrade. Support thinks the new model is simply worse and asks the LLM gateway team to roll back the model.
provided_evidence: 2025-03-12T10:00:00.970Z INFO ui-r req=req-3a91 tenant=t-initech latency_ms=970 status=ok

ground_truth.root_cause: No adapter registered for the tenant after upgrade; adapter layer falls back to base model (WARN in v3 logs).
ground_truth.version_caveat: On v3 a WARN fallback_to_base line exists; on v1/v2 the fallback is silent and only adapter_selected=base is visible.

scenario.query: How do I reset the device?
